A strengthened proxy that attributes the key phase on each of k disjoint contiguous folds, re-decodes the held-out complement under the same key, and aggregates fold-level rune-index self-consistency by an agreement rule can SEAL the gate: >=0.90 catch on the planted-45 AND on a fresh held-out surrogate, while keeping genuine-decode false-reject <=0.10.
